raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your equipment maintenance team is facing challenges with spreadsheet coordination and are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting solutions.

To better understand your specific requirements and how we can assist you, we would like to schedule a discovery meeting. This will allow us to explore your needs in detail and provide a tailored solution.

Please let us know a convenient time for you, and we will be happy to arrange the meeting at your earliest convenience.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
[Contact Information]
questions: What is the preferred time for the discovery meeting?
Are there any specific departments or stakeholders who should be present during the meeting?
uncertainties: The customer has not yet approved a budget, so we should be prepared to discuss potential cost structures or provide a general overview of pricing during the discovery meeting.
